notes.subject: יקבהו
notes.rationale: נקב 'ka minɛ / ka tɔgɔ fɔ ka a dogo' (pierce, designate by name) — KJV 'curse', YLT 'mark'

notes.subject: עורר
notes.rationale: עורר 'ka so' (rouse) ni ערר 'danga' bɛ kun tɛmɛ ɲɔgɔn kan — Heburukan ka daɲɛ-ɲɛfɔli, o tɛ se ka tɛmɛ Bamanankan na

notes.subject: Lewiyatan
notes.rationale: Lewiyatan — ji-jukɔrɔbagaw ka tɔgɔ min dogo la kosɛbɛ, min bɛ sɔrɔ Tanaki kɔnɔ ni kɔlɔlɔw de ye

translation: Ka ⟨a⟩ tɔgɔ da dangan na — don danganbagaw de, minnu labɛnna ka Lewiyatan so.
